checks.description: El chart deploy/k8s rechaza imágenes por tag y renderiza con imágenes por digest
checks.cmd: d=$(printf "a%.0s" $(seq 64)); t() { helm template t deploy/k8s --set-string images.api="$1" --set-string images.web="$1" --set-string database.password=x >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo ok || echo rejected; }; echo "tag=$(t ghcr.io/x/y:1.0.0) digest=$(t ghcr.io/x/y@sha256:$d)"

checks.description: Cada pod del chart corre sin root, sin token de Kubernetes, sin escalada ni capacidades, con seccomp y con límites
checks.cmd: d=$(printf "a%.0s" $(seq 64)); helm template t deploy/k8s --set-string images.api=ghcr.io/x/api@sha256:$d --set-string images.web=ghcr.io/x/web@sha256:$d --set-string database.password=x | yq -N 'select(.kind == "Deployment") | .metadata.name + ":" + ((.spec.template.spec.automountServiceAccountToken == false and .spec.template.spec.securityContext.runAsNonRoot == true and .spec.template.spec.securityContext.seccompProfile.type == "RuntimeDefault" and ([.spec.template.spec.containers[] | select(.securityContext.allowPrivilegeEscalation == false and (.securityContext.capabilities.drop | contains(["ALL"])) and .resources.limits.cpu != null and .resources.limits.memory != null)] | length) == (.spec.template.spec.containers | length)) | tostring)' | sort | paste -sd" "

checks.description: ops/cluster/access.yaml crea tablero-staging y tablero-production con Pod Security restricted
Cada environment es un usuario de Kubernetes con un Role solo en su namespace, sin comodines ni permisos de clúster
checks.cmd: f=ops/cluster/access.yaml; echo "$(yq -N 'select(.kind == "RoleBinding") | .metadata.namespace + "=" + (.subjects | map(.kind + "/" + .name) | join(","))' $f | sort | paste -sd" ") cluster=$(yq -N 'select(.kind == "ClusterRole" or .kind == "ClusterRoleBinding") | .kind' $f | wc -l) wildcards=$(yq -N 'select(.kind == "Role") | .rules[] | (.apiGroups + .resources + .verbs)[] | select(test("^\\*$"))' $f | wc -l)"

checks.description: authentication-config.yaml acepta solo tokens de GitHub con audiencia kind-gha, del id de tablero, desde main y de deploy.yml, y usa el environment como usuario
checks.cmd: f=ops/cluster/authentication-config.yaml; id=$(gh api "repos/$GH_REPO" --jq .id); printf "issuer=%s aud=%s repo=%s main=%s workflow=%s user=%s" "$(yq '.jwt[0].issuer.url' $f)" "$(yq '.jwt[0].issuer.audiences | join(",")' $f)" "$(grep -cF "claims.repository_id == '$id'" $f)" "$(grep -cF "claims.ref == 'refs/heads/main'" $f)" "$(grep -cF "claims.job_workflow_ref == '$GH_REPO/.github/workflows/deploy.yml@refs/heads/main'" $f)" "$(yq '.jwt[0].claimMappings.username.expression' $f)"
checks.assert: stdout~^issuer=https://token\.actions\.githubusercontent\.com aud=kind-gha repo=1 main=1 workflow=1 user='github:' \+ claims\.environment$

checks.description: El pod del runner monta el CA del clúster desde kube-root-ca.crt y sigue sin token de Kubernetes
checks.cmd: yq '"automount=" + (.template.spec.automountServiceAccountToken | tostring) + " ca=" + ([.template.spec.volumes[] | select(.configMap.name == "kube-root-ca.crt") | .name] | join(",")) + " mount=" + ([.template.spec.containers[0].volumeMounts[] | .mountPath] | join(","))' ops/arc/values.yaml

checks.description: Solo lab.yml y deploy.yml piden runners propios, y los dos se lanzan solo con workflow_dispatch
checks.cmd: yq -N 'select([.jobs[]."runs-on" | tostring | test("self-hosted|tablero-lab|tablero-runners")] | any) | (filename | sub(".*/"; "")) + ":" + (.on | keys | join(","))' .github/workflows/*.yml | sort | paste -sd" "

checks.description: El job verify de deploy.yml, en un runner de GitHub y con attestations: read como único permiso, verifica las imágenes firmadas por release.yml en runners de GitHub
checks.cmd: f=.github/workflows/deploy.yml; printf "runs-on=%s perms=%s verify=%s" "$(yq '.jobs.verify."runs-on"' $f)" "$(yq '.jobs.verify.permissions | to_entries | map(.key + "=" + .value) | join(",")' $f)" "$(yq '[.jobs.verify.steps[].run // "" | select(test("gh attestation verify") and test("--signer-workflow \"?\$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/\.github/workflows/release\.yml") and test("--deny-self-hosted-runners"))] | length' $f)"

checks.description: staging y production corren en tablero-runners, cada uno en su environment y en cola sin cancelar, y production espera a staging
checks.cmd: yq -N '.jobs | to_entries | .[] | select(.value.environment) | .key + ":env=" + (.value.environment | .name // .) + ",runs-on=" + .value."runs-on" + ",needs=" + ([.value.needs] | flatten | join("+")) + ",queue=" + ((.value.concurrency.group // "") != "" and .value.concurrency."cancel-in-progress" == false | tostring)' .github/workflows/deploy.yml | paste -sd" "

checks.description: Los jobs de despliegue usan ops/deploy/kubeconfig.yaml, sin credenciales dentro, que pide el token OIDC del job con audiencia kind-gha
checks.cmd: f=.github/workflows/deploy.yml; k=ops/deploy/kubeconfig.yaml; printf "perms=%s kubeconfig=%s exec=%s aud=%s creds=%s" "$(yq -N '(.jobs.staging, .jobs.production) | .permissions | to_entries | map(.key + "=" + .value) | sort | join(",")' $f | sort -u | paste -sd" ")" "$(yq -N '.jobs.staging.env.KUBECONFIG, .jobs.production.env.KUBECONFIG' $f | sort -u | paste -sd" ")" "$(yq '.users[0].user.exec.command' $k)" "$(grep -c "audience=kind-gha" ops/deploy/github-token.sh)" "$(yq '[.. | select(tag == "!!map") | keys[] | select(test("^(token|tokenFile|client-key|client-key-data|password)$"))] | length' $k)"

checks.description: Cada job de despliegue instala Helm con checksum, despliega las imágenes de verify con --rollback-on-failure y vuelve atrás si el smoke test falla
checks.cmd: f=.github/workflows/deploy.yml; for j in staging production; do printf "%s:helm=%s checksum=%s deploy=%s rollback=%s " $j "$(yq ".jobs.$j.env.HELM_VERSION" $f)" "$(yq "[.jobs.$j.steps[].run // \"\" | select(test(\"sha256sum -c\"))] | length" $f)" "$(yq "[.jobs.$j.steps[] | select((.run // \"\" | test(\"helm upgrade --install\")) and (.run | test(\"--rollback-on-failure\")) and (.env.API_IMAGE // \"\" | test(\"needs.verify.outputs.api\")) and (.env.WEB_IMAGE // \"\" | test(\"needs.verify.outputs.web\")))] | length" $f)" "$(yq "[.jobs.$j.steps[] | select((.run // \"\" | test(\"helm rollback\")) and (.if // \"\" | test(\"failure\")))] | length" $f)"; done
checks.assert: stdout~^staging:helm=v4\.3\.2 checksum=1 deploy=1 rollback=1 production:helm=v4\.3\.2 checksum=1 deploy=1 rollback=1 $

checks.description: release.yml lanza deploy.yml con la versión publicada tras las imágenes, desde un job con actions: write como único permiso
checks.cmd: f=.github/workflows/release.yml; printf "needs=%s perms=%s run=%s" "$(yq '.jobs.deploy.needs | join(",")' $f)" "$(yq '.jobs.deploy.permissions | to_entries | map(.key + "=" + .value) | join(",")' $f)" "$(yq '[.jobs.deploy.steps[].run // "" | select(test("gh workflow run deploy\.yml") and test("version="))] | length' $f)"

checks.description: actionlint y zizmor pasan sin hallazgos sobre los workflows de tablero
El apiserver de kind-gha tiene cargada exactamente ops/cluster/authentication-config.yaml
checks.cmd: h=$(sha256sum ops/cluster/authentication-config.yaml | cut -d" " -f1); kubectl get --raw /metrics | grep -c "^apiserver_authentication_config_controller_last_config_info{.*hash=\"sha256:$h\"}"

checks.description: En kind-gha, github:staging y github:production solo pueden desplegar en su propio namespace
checks.cmd: for u in staging production; do for n in staging production; do printf "%s@%s=%s " $u $n "$(kubectl auth can-i create deployments -n tablero-$n --as github:$u)"; done; done; printf "namespaces=%s" "$(kubectl auth can-i create namespaces --as github:production 2>/dev/null)"

checks.description: El historial de Helm de staging tiene una revisión fallida y un rollback automático
checks.cmd: helm history tablero -n tablero-staging -o json | jq -r '"failed=\(map(select(.status == "failed")) | length > 0) rollback=\(map(select(.description | startswith("Rollback to"))) | length > 0)"'

checks.description: tablero-production en kind-gha corre la última release de tablero, por el digest que cubren sus attestations
checks.cmd: owner=${GH_REPO%%/*}; v=$(gh release view --json tagName --jq .tagName); for c in api web; do want="ghcr.io/${owner,,}/tablero-$c@sha256:$(gh attestation verify "oci://ghcr.io/${owner,,}/tablero-$c:${v#v}" --repo "$GH_REPO" --format json --jq '.[0].verificationResult.statement.subject[0].digest.sha256')"; have=$(kubectl -n tablero-production get deploy $c -o jsonpath='{.spec.template.spec.containers[0].image}'); printf "%s=%s " $c "$([[ "$have" == "$want" ]] && echo "$v" || echo "${have:-ninguna}")"; done

checks.description: El run de deploy.yml de la última release terminó en success y su deployment de production quedó en success
checks.cmd: v=$(gh release view --json tagName --jq '.tagName | ltrimstr("v")'); read -r sha concl < <(gh run list --workflow deploy.yml --json displayTitle,headSha,conclusion --jq "[.[] | select(.displayTitle == \"deploy $v\")][0] | \"\(.headSha) \(.conclusion)\""); dep=$(gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/deployments?environment=production&sha=$sha" --jq '.[0].id'); echo "deploy=$concl production=$(gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/deployments/$dep/statuses" --jq '.[0].state')"
